text:
Chloe (CSM): Kickstarting prep for Marlin Labs budget tune & QBR. They spiked embed usage last week; need a 30d forecast, a short enablement plan, and a renewal health check.
Ravi (FinOps): Got it — pulling the token/embedding reports now. Will share a quick baseline and projection in ~15m.
Chloe (CSM): Great, drop the raw query/output here so AM/SE can triage.
Marcus (AM): Heads up — renewal in ~6 weeks. Customer mentioned latency when hitting bank data, but otherwise positive. I'll draft the renewal note once we have numbers.
Elena (SE): I can run a prompt/cost sweep to find obvious hotspots and propose caching/quantization changes. Could have a short playbook by EOD.
SpendAlertBot: ALERT: Marlin Labs spend +22% MoM. Top routes: /ingest (embeds), /search (rerank).
Ravi (FinOps): Pasting the run command I used: `
/spend report --account marlin-labs --window 30d --breakdown route,model
`
Ravi (FinOps): Quick snapshot: baseline ~1.2M tokens/month -> projected ~1.8M tokens/month at current trend (peak 62k tokens/day last week). Major cost drivers: high embed rate from /ingest and repeated long-context chat sessions.
Chloe (CSM): Initial recommendations: 1) Enable per-route soft quotas for /ingest; 2) Add short-term commit/discount options to reduce renewal churn risk; 3) SE to propose 2-3 prompt variants + caching to show 20-40% reduction on heavy routes.
Elena (SE): I'll draft 3 prompt variants and suggested cache TTLs (60s, 10m) and share a 1-hr enablement workshop agenda. Tentative: next Wed.
Marcus (AM): For the renewal narrative — do we want to flag as watch or at-risk? If we offer a 30% commit discount, that could stabilize spend and be a renewal hook.
Chloe (CSM): Mark as WATCH for now. Marcus, draft renewal options (no legal needed yet) with a commit scenario + projected run-rate delta. Ravi, can you run the delta for 30% commit vs. current run rate?
Ravi (FinOps): Yep. I'll post a small table in ~1h with current, projected, and post-commit run rates. Example format I'll use: `Account | Current MoM | Projected MoM | 30% Commit Run Rate | Delta`
Chloe (CSM): :thumbsup: Timeline: finalize slide deck by Monday EOD. Action items: Elena — prompt playbook + workshop invite; Marcus — renewal options + narrative; Ravi — detailed forecast + delta table; Chloe — assemble QBR deck + collect onboarding feedback.
Elena (SE): Sharing draft playbook (short):
- Replace heavy free-text prompt in /ingest with structured schema (saves ~25% tokens)
- Cache top-50 search queries for 10m TTL
- Quantize model selection on background reranks to 4-bit where latency allows
I'll add sample prompt variants and an A/B plan.
Chloe (CSM): Also pinging onboarding: they flagged two missing KB articles that led to support tickets this week — capture quotes for the renewal narrative please.
Marcus (AM): Noted, added KB gaps to the renewal narrative and asked onboarding for two customer quotes.
SpendAlertBot: INFO: Next automated spend digest scheduled in 2h.
Ravi (FinOps): Delta table posted: (short) Current MoM 1.8M tokens -> 30% commit run rate reduces effective unit cost ~18% and smooths monthly variance. I'll attach CSV in the deck.
Chloe (CSM): Thanks. Let's sync briefly Friday 11:00am to finalize slides. If anyone needs to move the date, call it out here.
Elena (SE): Workshop invite sent for Wed + draft playbook attached.
Marcus (AM): Renewal draft ready for review, added pricing options and the 'watch' flag.
Chloe (CSM): Awesome — closing the loop. We'll use the playbook and commit option as our primary remediation and present both in the QBR. If anything new pops up, add here.
